lines.text: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم و به ثقتی
lines.en: In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate, and in Him is my trust.

lines.text: الحمد لله رب العالمین والصلوة والسلام علی خیر خلقه محمد و آله الطیبین الطاهرین اجمعین
lines.en: Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds, and blessings and peace be upon the best of His creation, Muhammad, and his good and pure family, all of them.

lines.text: اما بعد این کتاب مشتمل است بر سی باب باب اول در شرح حساب جمل در قوم و بروج و کواکب
lines.en: As for what follows, this book comprises thirty chapters. Chapter one: on explaining the abjad reckoning among the people, and the signs of the zodiac, and the planets,

lines.text: و اسبوع و غیره باب دوّم در شرح افلاک و چگونگی کشش آن باب سیم در شرح بروج باب چهارم
lines.en: and the week, and so on. Chapter two: on the explanation of the spheres and the manner of their attraction. Chapter three: on the explanation of the signs of the zodiac. Chapter four:

lines.text: در منسوبات بروج باب پنجم در پدید کردن بروج زایده و ناقصه و عالیه و هابطه و مسرعه و مبطئه
lines.en: on the attributions of the signs of the zodiac. Chapter five: on making known the signs of the zodiac that are increasing, decreasing, ascending, descending, fast, and slow.

lines.text: باب ششم اندر پدید کردن بروج ناطقه و برصاء بزرگان و سفله گان و غیران باب هفتم در درجات
lines.en: Chapter six: on making apparent the signs of the zodiac that are speaking, leprous, great, base, and others. Chapter seven: on the degrees

lines.text: بروج ذوات الظل و مضیئه و خالصه و مظلمه باب هشتم در بیان درجات مذکر و مؤنث از بروج
lines.en: of the signs of the zodiac that have shadows, are luminous, pure, and dark. Chapter eight: on explaining the masculine and feminine degrees of the signs of the zodiac.

lines.text: باب نهم در بیان درجات منحوس و ابار و رقعه باب دهم در شرح کواکب از سعادت و نحوست و
lines.en: Chapter nine: on explaining the inauspicious degrees, and the wells, and the patches. Chapter ten: on explaining the planets in terms of auspiciousness and inauspiciousness, and

lines.en: masculinity and femininity, and so forth. Chapter eleven: on the attributions of the planets. Chapter twelve: on some attributions of the planets.

lines.text: باب سیزدهم در بیان ساعات روز و شب باب ۱۴ در بیان حدود و وجوه و مثلثات باب ۱۵

lines.en: on explaining the binding of the planets, and stepping over, and old age. Chapter 21: on explaining the lunar eclipse and the solar eclipse. Chapter 22:

lines.en: on explaining the lunar mansions. Chapter 23: on explaining the fixed stars and their directions. Chapter 24: on the chapter explaining the seven climes.

summary.headline: Thirty-Chapter Astrology Manual
summary.text: Contents of a thirty-chapter manual of judicial astrology, covering abjad reckoning, zodiacal signs and degrees, planetary attributes, hours, terms, faces, triplicities, apogees, nodes, houses, eclipses, lunar mansions, fixed stars, the seven climes, planetary conditions, tarrying, and lunar elections.
